prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a hit while turning left claim. Injury: knee injury. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1118; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Reviewed the first notice of loss for a left-turn collision at an intersection. Insured reports the other vehicle approached from the opposing direction and struck the driver's side. Police report requested. Photos of both vehicles requested from insured.

Entry 2: Spoke with the insured by phone. Insured states the light was green for their direction and believes the other driver was attempting to beat the signal. Recorded statement taken. Insured has no visible injuries and is driving a rental pending repair assessment.

Entry 3: Received notice that the third-party claimant is represented by counsel. Claimant reports a knee injury from the impact and is seeking medical treatment. All further contact to go through the attorney's office. Requested medical authorization and treatment records through counsel.

Entry 4: Field appraisal completed on the insured vehicle. Damage consistent with a side impact to the front quarter panel and driver door. Estimate under review. Reviewed the intersection camera footage received from the city, which shows the claimant vehicle entering on a yellow-to-red transition. Liability position under evaluation.

Entry 5: Call with claimant's attorney to discuss liability and the knee injury. Counsel has requested the file be held open while treatment continues. Advised that liability is disputed and that the medical file is needed before any evaluation of the bodily injury portion. Diary set for follow-up once records are received.
